{{Quote|Recall the Protocol of Hon Akua.|Kae Kwaad, to Nen Yim|<ref name="EOVII">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref>}}
The '''Protocol of Hon Akua''' was a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Shaping protocol|protocol]] used by the [[Shaper caste]]. It described the process by which [[Grutchin]], an [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] weapon used by the Yuuzhan Vong to attack enemy [[Starship/Legends|starships]], could be [[Terraforming/Legends|created]].<ref name="EOVII" /> In [[26 ABY/Legends|26.5 ABY]],<ref name="Date">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']] dates the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]'' to [[26 ABY/Legends|26.5 ABY]].</ref> [[Onimi]], the court jester of [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|Vong]] [[Supreme Overlord]] [[Shimrra Jamaane]], decided that he would use the knowledge found in this protocol to create a perfect grutchin while disguised as a [[Master Shaper]] named Kae Kwaad. Onimi did so as part of a plan to determine whether [[Shaper Adept]] [[Nen Yim]] would be able to design new protocols to fill the almost empty [[eighth cortex]].<ref name="EOVII" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Protocol of Hon Akua appeared in the [[2001]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]'', written by [[Greg Keyes]] as part of the ''[[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order]]'' novel series' [[Edge of Victory Duology|''Edge of Victory'' Duology]].<ref name="EOVII" />
